rationale: Stiven's work on real-time 3D computer vision and ML for surgical AR at Braillic aligns directly with Artem's expertise in shipping real-time inference systems and vision-language models—Artem's background in PyTorch-based model implementation could be particularly valuable as Braillic scales its ArNav platform. Both are deeply technical (CTO and ML engineer) with complementary skill sets: Stiven needs ML infrastructure support to grow his team, and Artem has proven experience optimizing ML systems for production.
intro_message: Stiven Ding, meet Artem Yatsenko — your real-time vision-language model expertise could be key to scaling Braillic's surgical AR navigation platform.
